echoParts: Is any one of you suffering?
verseText: Is any one of you suffering? He should pray. Is anyone cheerful? He should sing praises.
meaning: Whenever trouble comes, our first step should be to pray to God for help.

recall.question: What does this verse tell us to do when we're suffering (going through something hard)?

meaning.question: This verse tells us to pray when we're hurting and sing praises when we're cheerful. What does that teach us?
choices: Turn to God in every situation
Only pray when you need something
Only thank God when life is easy

application.prompt: Whether you're having the best day, the worst day, or something in-between, you can always turn to God! When something is troubling you, tell Him about it. And when something makes you happy, remember to thank Him. What's something you can thank him for today?
